formal_statement: ∀ (gates : List PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Gate) (out : ℕ), (∀ g ∈ gates, (g.op = PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.GateOp.and ∨ g.op = PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.GateOp.or) ∧ g.inputs.length ≤ 2) → (∀ (i : Fin gates.length), ∀ w ∈ (gates.get i).inputs, w < 26 + (i : ℕ)) → (∀ p l : Fin 13, p - l ∈ ({0, 1, 3, 9} : Finset (Fin 13)) → PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit.eval ⟨gates, out⟩ (List.ofFn (fun u1 : Fin 13 => decide (u1 = p)) ++ List.ofFn (fun v1 : Fin 13 => decide (v1 = l))) = true) → (∀ Q : Finset (Fin 13), Q.card = 4 → (∀ k : Fin 13, (Q.filter (fun u0 : Fin 13 => u0 - k ∈ ({0, 1, 3, 9} : Finset (Fin 13)))).card ≤ 2) → PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit.eval ⟨gates, out⟩ (List.ofFn (fun u2 : Fin 13 => decide (u2 ∈ Q)) ++ List.ofFn (fun v2 : Fin 13 => decide (∀ r ∈ Q, r - v2 ∉ ({0, 1, 3, 9} : Finset (Fin 13))))) = false) → 64 ≤ gates.length
plain_statement: Plane of order 3: inputs x_0..x_12 for points, then y_0..y_12 for lines, line l being {l, l+1, l+3, l+9} mod 13. An incident input sets exactly x_p and y_l true with p on l. A quadrangle input takes 4 points Q, no 3 on a line, sets x true exactly on Q and y true exactly on the lines meeting Q in no point. Every list of AND/OR gates of fan-in at most two, each gate reading only earlier wires, with a wire true on every incident input and false on every quadrangle input has at least 64 gates.
title: Plane of order 3: every AND/OR list of fan-in at most two accepting every incident point-line input and rejecting every quadrangle input has at least 64 gates
